name: 137. MCP client registration validation (mcp-registration-validation)
description: Management-endpoint checks with no live provider involved. POST /api/mcp/client must validate connection_type against the enum (http, sse, stdio) before anything else, and an anonymous registration of an unresolvable target must be refused; on the OSS gateway the setup lock answers it with 401 before the handler, whose fail-closed rule for auth-bypassed callers is unit-tested in handlers/mcpregistrationguard_test.go. DELETE /api/mcp/client/<id> for an id no client has must answer 404, not 500.
